<reason>PRO won by holding a selective standard and winning the price-theory comparison: lower cost floor does not equal lower price without pressure. A answered B's cost-floor pressure honestly then turned it into could vs would, exposed B's scale-barrier vs entry tension, and showed highest bid can price neutralization. B overplayed the concession and never answered closeness of competition.</reason>
